B: Null: generic claim insufficient; competing explanation/safety constraint applies
C: Compare at least three third-party fantasy-politics products from primary own pages against draft roster, objective points, leaderboard and game cadence. Adversarial: distinguish operating product from promotional claim, do not profile or score real politicians. Sources Politiplay, Politiparty, Fantasy Parliament already found during exploratory discovery; source discovery prior to prereg disclosed.
primary_endpoint: Binary matrix 3x4 with citeable official feature text; novelty of generic fantasy roster null if at least two describe both draft and leaderboard.
D: Original primary official source or exact code, log access and limits
F: Review competent prior art/control; document selection exposure and confound
H: Update source/prior ledger based on evidence
I: Assessment of novelty, validity, ethics, replicability separately; grade 0/3 unless genuinely independent
selection_exposure: C12 competitor names and C15 W3C pages discovered before prereg; no confirmatory independent novelty claim.
